title: azalea macrosepala
intro: Azalea macrosepala, commonly known as the Spreading Azalea, is a flowering plant species native to China. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Azalea macrosepala include promoting relaxation and reducing stress through its sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
